dedupe_keys.name: mobile device based bluetooth low energy database

description: This Bluetooth Low Energy database supports calibration and testing of collaborative indoor positioning with mobile devices. Its research team, including Universitat Jaume I, Tampere University and Spanish research partners, publishes the supplementary measurements on Zenodo. The deposit groups raw observations, processed data and code into three folders, allowing comparisons between processing choices, not providing only final positioning errors. MATLAB routines accompany the experimental observations. The repository describes five mobile devices and local indoor experiments; its public metadata does not establish a complete calendar span or universal sampling interval. The record is freely accessible under CC BY 4.0. Device counts and experimental roles require careful interpretation because the article also discusses receivers; these should not be silently equated. The measurements can inform signal-strength and ranging components of building-scale digital twins and positioning simulations. They complement radio-system models such as model-vienna-5g-simulators, but the transfer of Bluetooth-specific observations to other frequencies, hardware or room layouts requires separate validation.
